The displayed method distribution exactly matched the event distribution at 11 KO / 0 SUB / 3 DEC. Do not apply an anti-decision correction; localization, not aggregate class balance, remains the method issue.
The calibrated method layer clearly beat baseline and residual on this prospective card and should remain the leading method shadow.
The winner reference again edged v0.32 shadow on Brier and log loss despite identical 13-1 sides, so v0.32 winner is not promoted.
Timing leans were only 8-6 and the lone official timing wager lost. Keep the 12-point timing edge gate and do not relax timing promotion.

Sparse timing conflicts were correctly treated cautiously: several huge model-only timing edges in debutant/sparse fights would have lost. Codify sparse-evidence timing blocking rather than relying only on manual judgment.
Gautier-Kopylov was a winner-side failure, not a finish-class failure: the model correctly expected KO/TKO but assigned the winner incorrectly.
UFC 332 was an extreme finish environment with 11 KO/TKOs and nine first-round knockouts; record the event, but do not globally retrain toward first-round finishes from one outlier card.
